name: SAMSARA
author: Tomorrow's Man, from AMB-1 by Charles Vestal
tagline: An ambient piece for the FM-1 that never repeats and never stands still
description: SAMSARA turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into a slow generative ambient piece that changes in tone, harmony and density over hours: a pad, soft bells, a gliding bass and a rare low ground that come and go like weather, through a tape echo and a wandering plate. Four pieces (Samsara, Maranasati, Anatta, Nirvana) and four knobs: Mood, Density, Drift, Space. It is a fork of Charles Vestal's AMB-1.
credits: From AMB-1 by Charles Vestal. Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
